_meta.batch: Tadpole 01 INTRO (13 terminow) - poczatek luku postaci Tadpole (Madam Tadpole). Kolejna postac po Symmetry.
_meta.character_voice: Tadpole: pewna siebie, bezposrednia, zartobliwy/rzeczowy ton ('Great question', 'Go.', 'Yup') - twierdzi ze jest 'w polowie syrena' (zart - w rzeczywistosci tylko swietna plywaczka).

Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.en:
The [h]top[/h] half - obviously.
From the waist up? [i]All mermaid.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl:
[h]Górna[/h] połowa - oczywiście.
Od pasa w górę? [i]Cała syrena.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: ...and as you can see I have the legs of an ordinary human woman.
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: ...a jak widzicie, mam nogi zwykłej ludzkiej kobiety.
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Who... [i]happens[/i] to be an olympic-level swimmer.
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: Która... [i]akurat[/i] jest pływaczką na poziomie olimpijskim.
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.en:
It's me, Madam Tadpole.
Yup, that's my name.
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl:
To ja, Madam Tadpole.
Tak, to moje imię.
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Are you a mermaid, or - what's the deal?
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: Jesteś syreną, czy - o co chodzi?
Conversation/Tadpole 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sally
